full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to establish a Rehabilitation and Bankruptcy Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") within the National Court Administration in order to formulate policies, improve systems, and ensure systematic and uniform supervision of persons involved in rehabilitation and bankruptcy proceedings, and to prescribe matters necessary for the operation thereof.
